reasons: The cited clause (p0042) genuinely deviates from the preferred position: it is a symmetric consent-based restriction with no affiliate/successor carve-out for Company and no bar on Contractor assigning to a Customer competitor, matching only the fallback.

The redline reaches the preferred position with a minimal append: the original mutual consent sentence is preserved verbatim and a proviso adds (i) Company's consent-free assignment to an affiliate or successor in a merger/acquisition/reorganization/sale of substantially all assets, (ii) a prohibition on Contractor assigning to a Company competitor, and (iii) a confirming no-change-of-control-trigger sentence.
The failed 'minimal edit' check is advisory only — the high changed-character ratio reflects added proviso text on a short clause, not a rewrite; no existing language was deleted or weakened.

The comment is accurate (correctly notes no existing change-of-control trigger, so the added sentence is confirmatory), uses the required prefix and first-person plural tone, and explains what changed and why without lecturing.
